findings.summary: The regional Washington, DC / DC-metro record binds to the open Silver Spring branch at 928 Ellsworth Drive, not to a separate District storefront.
Complete current exact-branch surfaces yield 69 unique food products after consolidating repeated Toast feature cards and excluding all alcohol.
Glenarden, Arundel Mills, and Gaithersburg products were not imported; 18 frozen sibling-only food rows remain location mismatches.
Silver Spring, VISIT ONE OF OUR RESTAURANTS, and Woodfire Club are navigation/location labels, not products.
All four required searches found no complete exact-branch multi-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy; only selective direct positives and the gluten-free preparation menu are retained.
